description: This source file defines the static class 'PdfEncoders' which provides various encoding helper functions for PDF string and byte conversions, encoding them into different formats such as literal, hexadecimal, and with potential encryption, primarily used internally within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfEncoders
classes.description: A static helper class providing encoding functions for PDF string processing, including methods for encoding literals, hex strings, and handling encryption, tailored for internal use within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: FormatStringLiteral
methods.description: Formats a byte array into a PDF string or hex literal, optionally encrypting the data.
